findings.where: Top nav, the 'Destinations' link (desktop inline, and in the phone Menu panel)
findings.fault: The link points to #destinations, an anchor on this page, and this page has no destinations section. Clicking it does nothing visible. It is the only link in the nav that goes anywhere other than this page.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker who has just read how ranking works and wants to see ranked hostels in Bali or Lombok. Their one way forward is a dead link, so they are stuck on a page that has no other route into the product.

findings.where: Footer links 'Privacy', 'Terms' and 'Report content', and the nav wordmark 'MantaHostels home'
findings.fault: Each of these links points back to this same page. They look like working links (underlined, or the wordmark in its usual home position), but clicking one just reloads 'How we rank'. Privacy and Terms never open, Report content gives no way to report, and the logo never reaches home.
findings.who_objects: A visitor checking the site's policies before trusting it, on a page whose whole purpose is earning that trust, finds the legal links dead. The same goes for a hostel owner or guest trying to report a review, and for anyone who taps the logo to go home. A dead Privacy link on a trust page suggests the site is unfinished. The email link is the only workaround, and it only covers reporting.
